mapper.select: SELECT id,public_id,title,document_type,product_id,active_version_id FROM knowledge_document WHERE public_id=#{publicId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,public_id,title,document_type,product_id,active_version_id FROM knowledge_document WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT v.id FROM knowledge_document_version v WHERE (v.status='PROCESSING' AND (v.lease_until IS NULL OR v.lease_until<=NOW(6))) OR (v.status='PENDING' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_ingest_outbox o WHERE o.document_version_id=v.id AND o.status='PUBLISHED' AND o.published_at<DATE_SUB(NOW(6),INTERVAL 3 MINUTE))) ORDER BY v.id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_ingest_outbox o JOIN knowledge_document_version v ON v.id=o.document_version_id SET o.status='PENDING',o.attempts=0,o.next_attempt_at=NOW(6),o.published_at=NULL,o.last_error=NULL WHERE v.id=#{id} AND v.status='PENDING' AND o.status='PUBLISHED' AND o.published_at<DATE_SUB(NOW(6),INTERVAL 3 MINUTE)
UPDATE knowledge_document_version SET lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(6),INTERVAL 3 MINUTE) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until>NOW(6)
UPDATE knowledge_document_version SET status='FAILED',error_message='处理超时，请查看最新版本的恢复结果',lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=NOW(6))
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM knowledge_document_version WHERE retry_of_version_id=#{id}
SELECT attempt_no FROM knowledge_document_version WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document_version(document_id,version_no,source_name,storage_path,status,attempt_no,retry_of_version_id) SELECT document_id,#{versionNo},source_name,storage_path,'PENDING',#{attempt},id FROM knowledge_document_version WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED'
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document_version v JOIN knowledge_ingest_outbox o ON o.document_version_id=v.id SET v.status='FAILED',v.error_message='消息投递连续失败，请在依赖恢复后重试' WHERE o.id=#{id} AND o.status='PENDING' AND o.attempts>=5 AND v.status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no),0)+1 FROM knowledge_document_version WHERE document_id=#{documentId}
SELECT FROM knowledge_document_version v JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id=v.document_id WHERE v.document_id=#{documentId} AND v.version_no=#{versionNo}
SELECT FROM knowledge_document_version v JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id=v.document_id WHERE v.id=#{id}

SELECT d.public_id,d.title,d.document_type,d.product_id,d.active_version_id, (SELECT v.id FROM knowledge_document_version v WHERE v.document_id=d.id ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1) latest_version_id, (SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM knowledge_document_version v WHERE v.document_id=d.id) latest_version, (SELECT v.status FROM knowledge_document_version v WHERE v.document_id=d.id ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1) latest_status, (SELECT v.error_message FROM knowledge_document_version v WHERE v.document_id=d.id ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1) error_message, d.created_at FROM knowledge_document d ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document_version SET status='PROCESSING',error_message=NULL,lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(6),INTERVAL 3 MINUTE) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE knowledge_document_version SET status='FAILED',error_message=#{message},lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE knowledge_document_version SET status='READY',error_message=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until>NOW(6)

UPDATE knowledge_document d JOIN knowledge_document_version candidate ON candidate.id=#{versionId} AND candidate.document_id=d.id LEFT JOIN knowledge_document_version active ON active.id=d.active_version_id SET d.active_version_id=candidate.id WHERE d.id=#{documentId} AND candidate.status='READY' AND (active.id IS NULL OR active.version_no<candidate.version_no)
mapper.select: SELECT active_version_id FROM knowledge_document WHERE document_type=#{documentType} AND active_version_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IN #{id}

SELECT id,document_version_id,payload_json,attempts,created_at FROM knowledge_ingest_outbox WHERE status='PENDING' AND attempts < 5 AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_ingest_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE knowledge_ingest_outbox SET attempts=attempts+1,last_error=#{message},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_ingest_outbox WHERE status='PENDING'
